label: P6 pre-registration (feat/parity-p6 from feat/parity-p5 c76bb99c). Written and committed BEFORE the first leg; every hypothesis, reading rule and gate threshold is fixed here. Nothing below changes after data exists; an amendment would be a NEW file, named as such.

step0.sso: checked 17:43Z: role credentials valid to 19:31Z — within 2 h of expiry, so a login was required; Ansh approved it at 17:44Z (the new SSO session carries a refresh token and outlasts the 8 h budget)
step0.origin: feat/parity-p5 on origin = c76bb99c; feat/parity-p6 created from it

recorded.p5_verdict_stands: P5's verdict stands unchanged: S1 does not hold, P5-B NOT RUN. P6 is a NEW experiment informed by P5's data, not a re-reading of P5.
recorded.register_64_applied: every equivalence or superiority claim in P6 uses a FIXED tolerance stated here, never a noise-derived one. P5's forward clause asked for zero degradation under concurrent decoding, which LlamaIndex itself does not achieve (1.40x in P4); P6 reports forward degradation as a number and never gates on it.

carried_rules.mandate: ONE engine process, ONE pipeline (one token), ONE model instance per model; threads unrestricted. D0 after every leg and block (G_d0: RocketRide on-token D0 pre and post, mandate clean, exactly ONE LWDETR; LlamaIndex one container, one process, --workers 1); a violation or absent evidence stops the run (exit 9).
carried_rules.rulings: A (32 vCPU, unconstrained) and C (one workload at a time)
carried_rules.retries: at most two per smoke leg; DEGRADED-with-all-rows kept. P6-B blocks are not retried (a retry would break the alternation); a failed block is recorded FAILED.
carried_rules.abab_and_canary: every comparison interleaved ABAB inside its stage; the canary (the P3-B bare microbenchmark in rr:patched-video on v00_EN2001a's 239 frames, T=4, one caller, alone) before every round and in P6-B before block 1 and after block 6; it explains drift and adjusts nothing
carried_rules.per_leg: steal, CPU model, MHz, boot id; percore sampler; 1 Hz memory sampler verified non-empty after the first leg (exit 10)
carried_rules.images: NO build: rr:p5-infer (sha256:b42c03b6…, P5's image) is used as it is — the chain refuses unless its id reads back as P5's; rr:patched, rr:patched-video, li:video and rr:p5-infer ids read back at every stage's start and end
carried_rules.driver_change: one harness change, opt-in: working/video/driver_video.py --warm-sends N --warm-concurrency C (P6 warm symmetry: exactly N warm sends over the warm rows at concurrency C, the same policy on both arms, recorded in the warm-up ledger as warm_sends_declared / warm_concurrency_declared; the per-arm coverage gates still apply). Without the flags the driver is unchanged (Crossroad 40). Laptop test working/scripts/p6_warm_test.py, with a null control; the existing test_warmup_distribution.py passes unchanged.

budget: 8 hours from the run stage's first leg (P6_DEADLINE_EPOCH = that start + 28,800 s). Order: P6-A smoke, P6-B (only if its gate fires), P6-C. P6-D on the laptop. Past the budget the leg or block in flight finishes and the rest is NOT RUN; report; stop the box.

P6_A.hypothesis: rr:p5-infer at K=16 runs at least 0.95 of one LlamaIndex instance, and at least 1.20x stock.
evidence_before: P5, one session, output identical 16/16: P5 over LlamaIndex 1.349 in round 1, 1.397 in round 2
P5 over stock: +75.5% in round 1, +73.0% in round 2
P6_A.cells: the 16-video AMI slice, T=4 (six vars = 4), stamped, two ABAB rounds, each after the canary: p6c_can_a<r>, p6a_stock16_<r> (rr:patched-video, one token, K=16), p6a_p5k16_<r> (rr:p5-infer, one token, K=16), p6a_li16_<r> (li:video, one instance, K=16)
P6_A.CORRECTNESS: HARD, after each round's P5 leg (G_correct_A<r>): p6a_p5k16_<r> output identical (per-video chunk sha256 AND frame scores) to p6a_stock16_<r> on 16/16 videos. A failure stops P6 (exit 13): OUTPUT-CHANGING, no speed reading.

readings.Q1_PARITY: holds iff fps(P5 K=16) / fps(LI K=16) >= 0.95
readings.Q2_SPEEDUP: holds iff fps(P5 K=16) / fps(stock K=16) >= 1.20
readings.per_round_and_pooled: each read per round (that round's legs) and pooled (the cell means of the two rounds)
readings.DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY: forward degradation: the P5 forward at K=16 (mean, p50, p99 of the cell) over P5's K=1 forward reference (the committed parity_p5 p5a_p5k1_1/2: the means of their mean, p50 and p99) — reported as numbers, CROSS-SESSION, never gated
readings.frames_per_s: export total_frames / total_span_s; the per-leg metrics are P5's (p5_analyse_a.leg)

P6_A.SMOKE_GATE_P6B: G_smoke_P6B fires iff correctness holds in both rounds AND Q1 holds in round 1 AND in round 2 AND pooled. Q2 is reported and does not gate.

P6_B.design: RR P5 K=16 vs LI one instance K=16, T=4, stamped; the 168-video slice (the first 168 measured manifest rows) in 11 blocks (10 x 16, then 8), arms alternating block by block (odd blocks RR first, even blocks LI first), each arm processing all 168 exactly once; one container per arm for the whole stage, the idle arm PAUSED (docker pause), its cgroup CPU over every block recorded
P6_B.warm_symmetry: fixes the P5 runner. At container start each arm runs its one-time long warm-up: 16 warm sends at concurrency 16 (LlamaIndex's Crossroad 40 K=16 wave; RocketRide given the same) through --warm-sends 16 --warm-concurrency 16, in a start-warm driver run whose one measured video (the first of the 168) is EXCLUDED from measurement (p6b_<arm>_startwarm). After EVERY resume both arms process the same small warm set — 2 warm sends at concurrency 2 (--warm-sends 2 --warm-concurrency 2) — inside the block's own driver run (RocketRide's model lives in the run's task process), excluded from measurement.
P6_B.gates_per_block: G_d0, G_cell (T=4, K=16, n = the block's videos) and G_warm (the ledger declares and shows exactly 2 sends at concurrency 2, every one served; 16 at 16 for the start warms); a failure stops the stage
P6_B.canary: before block 1 (both service containers paused, none running) and after block 6
P6_B.report: per-arm total frames/s (sum of frames / sum of the blocks' spans) and the ratio RR/LI against Q1's 0.95; the per-block ratio distribution (min, p50, max); errors, D0, cell and warm outcomes per block; the paused arm's CPU per block
P6_B.CORRECTNESS: P5 output per video identical to the banked P1-D stock RR T=4 168-video output (parity_p1_20260923T184000Z/v1full_rr_t4); every differing video named

P6_C.hypothesis: With a single inference thread, more intra-op threads now speed up the forward, because callers no longer contend for the model.
evidence_before: RR's out-of-box posture is torch 16 threads
S5-A's finding that T=16 was no faster than T=2 was measured with 16 contending callers
P5's inference thread is 99.97% busy, so frames/s is bound by forward time alone
P6_C.cells: the 16-video slice, K=16, two ABAB rounds, each after the canary: p6c_p5t16_<r> (rr:p5-infer with the six thread variables UNSET, as out of box; the driver's --rr-threads-env unset) and p6c_lit16_<r> (li:video one instance with the six variables = 16). Torch threads read back in-process on both (P5: on the inference thread); G_cell requires 16 on both and, for P5, the six variables absent.
P6_C.CORRECTNESS: p6c_p5t16_1 output identical on 16/16 videos to the committed out-of-box RR output (the default-posture 16-video leg of V1: parity_p0_20260923T083031Z/v1_rr_def_a — P1-A ran no default-posture leg; P0's V1 is the committed out-of-box reference). HARD for P6-C: if it differs, P6-C stops and gives no speed reading.

readings.T16_FORWARD: fixed tolerance: F(P5 T=16) / F(P5 T=4) <= 0.95 (faster by at least 5%), F(P5 T=4) = P6-A's p6a_p5k16 cell; per round (P6-C round r against P6-A round r) and pooled (cell means)
readings.T16_PARITY: fps(P5 T=16) / fps(LI T=16), reported against 0.95
readings.not_interleaved: the T=16 vs T=4 comparison crosses stages of the session (P6-A, then P6-B, then P6-C), as the question specifies; it is NOT ABAB-protected. The canary per round (P6-A and P6-C) is reported beside it and adjusts nothing.

gates.list: G_alone before every leg; G_d0, G_cell after every leg and block; G_warm where a warm set is declared; G_memstat after the first leg; G_canary after every canary; G_correct_A1/A2 (hard); G_smoke_P6B; G_correct_C1 (hard for P6-C)
gates.GATE_CONTROLS: p6_gate_controls.py runs every gate whole in its real runtime against a positive (must PASS) and a null (must FAIL) before launch; the run stage refuses without an all_pass record. Control targets: committed legs (P0, P3, P5, batch-size smoke) and the control stage's real legs p6ctl_p5t16 (rr:p5-infer, six vars unset), p6ctl_lit16 (li:video T=16), p6ctl_warm_rr and p6ctl_warm_li (T=4, --warm-sends 2 --warm-concurrency 2) — each K=2, 2 videos, stamped, through the chain's own leg(); gate-control targets, not measured legs.

deliverable: one P6 report: the gate table with each gate's control results; correctness before speed; Q1 and Q2 per round and pooled; the P6-B result or NOT RUN; the P6-C reading; the canary drift note; both drafts. Blind recompute with planted figures. Stop the box and read back its state.
